prompt: Add a create action to UsersController that validates params, saves the user, and redirects to index with a flash success message on success, or redirects back with an error flash on failure.
completion:
class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def create
    user = User.new(user_params.validate!)
    if user.save
      redirect_to(action: :index, flash: {"success" => "User created successfully!"})
    else
      redirect_to(action: :new, flash: {"error" => "Could not create user."})
    end
  end

  def user_params
    params.validation do
      required(:name) { |p| p.name? & !p.name.empty? }
      required(:email, "Email is invalid") { |p| p.email? }
    end
  end
end

prompt: Write an OrdersController with a before_action filter that runs for all actions, plus a show and delete action.
completion:
class OrdersController < ApplicationController
  before_action do
    all { require_login }
  end

  def show
    order = Order.find(params[:id])
    render("show.slang")
  end

  def delete
    Order.find(params[:id]).destroy
    redirect_to(action: :index, flash: {"notice" => "Order deleted."})
  end

  private def require_login
    halt!(403, "Forbidden") unless session[:current_user_id]?
  end
end

prompt: I need a versioned JSON API in Amber under /api/v1 with routes for a ProductsController. How do I scope that?

  pipeline :api do
    plug Amber::Pipe::Logger.new
  end

  routes :api, "/api" do
    namespace "/v1" do
      get "/products", ProductsController, :index
      get "/products/:id", ProductsController, :show
      post "/products", ProductsController, :create
      put "/products/:id", ProductsController, :update
      delete "/products/:id", ProductsController, :destroy

  end
end
